LanguageData.QuickMenu.Notice.FirstRun.Title: Quick Menu is ready
LanguageData.QuickMenu.Notice.FirstRun.Body: Press Mouse 4 (a side mouse button) on the map to open the quick menu. No side button? Use the middle mouse button instead.
LanguageData.QuickMenu.Notice.Mint: Dubs Mint Menus is active: pin with Alt+click, so Ctrl+click stays with Mint. You can change this in the Quick Menu settings.
